title: Culturele Veranderingen in Nederland 2004 - CV'04
contributors: Intomart GfK - United Fieldwork Organisation - Ufo
descriptions: Trend study on changes in social and cultural opinions and attitudes of the Dutch population regarding a wide range of topics.Safety and crime / satisfaction with life / social contacts / spending leisure time / possessions and income / prosperity / health and handicaps / work / use of internet / economic well-being / values and beliefs / satisfaction with government / religious issues and philosophy of life / political participation and interest / emancipation of women / opinions on immigrants.
